name: Custom Yard Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality corrugated plastic sheet, offering a lightweight, durable, and weather-resistant outdoor display solution.
    - Made with a 5mm thickness, providing a sturdy structure while remaining easy to handle and install.
    - Designed for outdoor use with a fade-resistant surface that helps maintain the design’s appearance over time.
    - Includes wire stakes for quick and convenient placement in lawns, yards, gardens, and outdoor event spaces.
    - The material is lightweight yet strong enough for everyday outdoor decoration and promotional display use.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in the following size options:
              +) 18 x 12 in ~ 45.72 x 30.48 cm with wire stake size  25.4 x 38.1 cm ~ 10 x 15 in.
              +) 24 x 18 in ~ 60.96 x 45.72 cm with wire stake size  25.4 x 60.96 cm ~ 10 x 24 in.
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality all-over heat transfer printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Double-sided printing.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a decorative outdoor sign and a personalized event display.
    - Designed for quick setup in lawns, yards, gardens, walkways, and outdoor venue spaces using the included wire stakes.
    - Suitable for birthdays, anniversaries, graduations, patriotic celebrations, holidays, welcome signs, and promotional displays.
    - Lightweight and easy to move, making it convenient for temporary or seasonal outdoor use.
    - Perfect for adding a bold and personalized touch to any outdoor celebration or announcement.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, friends, neighbors, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, patriotic holidays, graduations, retirement parties, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for outdoor décor lovers, event planners, homeowners, and anyone who enjoys personalized signage.
    - A thoughtful choice for yard decorations, party setups, lawn displays, and custom outdoor messages.
    - Great for home celebrations, event entrances, garden decoration, and business promotions.
    - Adds a festive, personalized, and memorable touch to any outdoor space 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Yard Sign

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 1-3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
